_description: The NESCA megaplume on a ladder of verified heat fluxes, the ratios that follow, and the heat that lava cooling and dyke heating deliver over two of their parameters.

megaplume_mean_power._note: Heat range of the source test, divided by the eruption duration. The lowest power is the floor released over 100 h; the highest is the ceiling released over 1 h.

_definitions.large_vent_field_basis: upper end of the verified vent-field range (Lucky Strike, barreyre2012structure)

vent_field_time_for_one_megaplume._note: Time a vent field discharging steadily at the given power needs to release the megaplume floor and ceiling of results/model_comparison.json.

megaplume_share_of_one_year_axial._note: Heat of one megaplume (floor, ceiling) as a fraction of one year of hydrothermal output of the global ridge axis (2-4 TW, Elderfield and Schultz 1996).
